stamps.E251: case (5) is REVISED - a module import beside a member import of the same module MERGES into the `self` form: `import std::reactive; import std::reactive::{ draft };` becomes `import std::reactive::{ self, draft };` (probed on v0.43.0: `import std::json::{ self, Json };` resolves both `json::` and `Json`). `self` sorts first in the group; `self as name` keeps its alias and merges the same way.
